title: How Ancient People Kept Cats
synopsis: Cats have been a part of the family in China since ancient times!

fullText.simplified:
古代人的生活——古代人怎么养猫

    作为最常见的宠物之一，猫被人类饲养的历史十分悠久。在中国古代人眼中，万物有灵，猫尤其如此。从最初的仓库守卫者，到通佛性的灵者，猫与古代中国人的羁绊似乎越来越深。
    秦汉时期，为了震慑老鼠，减少仓库的损失，人们选择养猫。人们把猫定位为看守仓库的卫士，会在农历十二月八日祭祀猫神。这一时期，猫逐渐成为了家庭成员，人们开始给猫取名字。
    到了唐宋时期，猫从仓库卫士变成了伴侣宠物，已经出现了一些人开始像对待家人一样对待猫的现象。到了宋朝，养猫开始有了固定的流程：第一步，看日历。人们通过专门的养猫日历，选择一个适合迎接猫回家的日子。日子一到，就来到了第二步，下聘礼。在这一天，人们要带着契约书和聘礼来迎接小猫回家。契约书上不但写着猫的外貌和性格，还写着“要把小猫带回家共度一生，请各位神仙见证”这样的话。聘礼则是送给猫妈妈的主人的，一般是小鱼或者盐；如果是野生的小猫，也要串一串小鱼送给猫妈妈。回家以后就是第三步，进门。在这一步，人们要带小猫认识家里人，也会跟家神和狗打招呼。总的来说，就是简易的娶妻流程。可以说，宋代人已经很接近当代的猫奴了。
    说到当代猫奴，猫的陪伴，猫的懒，猫的淘气，都是当代猫奴喜欢猫的原因。古代人也是如此。从宋代开始，就有很多人给自己的猫写诗了，给猫洗澡、驱虫这些就更不用提了，都有专门的时间和方法。总的来说，古代人和现代人爱猫的心情是共通的。毕竟，能让自己生活得更快乐的东西，是让人无法拒绝的。
fullText.traditional:
古代人的生活——古代人怎麼養貓

    作為最常見的寵物之一，貓被人類飼養的歷史十分悠久。在中國古代人眼中，萬物有靈，貓尤其如此。從最初的倉庫守衛者，到通佛性的靈者，貓與古代中國人的羈絆似乎越來越深。
    秦漢時期，為了震懾老鼠，減少倉庫的損失，人們選擇養貓。人們把貓定位為看守倉庫的衛士，會在農曆十二月八日祭祀貓神。這一時期，貓逐漸成為了家庭成員，人們開始給貓取名字。
    到了唐宋時期，貓從倉庫衛士變成了伴侶寵物，已經出現了一些人開始像對待家人一樣對待貓的現象。到了宋朝，養貓開始有了固定的流程：第一步，看日曆。人們通過專門的養貓日曆，選擇一個適合迎接貓回家的日子。日子一到，就來到了第二步，下聘禮。在這一天，人們要帶著契約書和聘禮來迎接小貓回家。契約書上不但寫著貓的外貌和性格，還寫著“要把小貓帶回家共度一生，請各位神仙見證”這樣的話。聘禮則是送給貓媽媽的主人的，一般是小魚或者鹽；如果是野生的小貓，也要串一串小魚送給貓媽媽。回家以後就是第三步，進門。在這一步，人們要帶小貓認識家裡人，也會跟家神和狗打招呼。總的來說，就是簡易的娶妻流程。可以說，宋代人已經很接近當代的貓奴了。
    說到當代貓奴，貓的陪伴，貓的懶，貓的淘氣，都是當代貓奴喜歡貓的原因。古代人也是如此。從宋代開始，就有很多人給自己的貓寫詩了，給貓洗澡、驅蟲這些就更不用提了，都有專門的時間和方法。總的來說，古代人和現代人愛貓的心情是共通的。畢竟，能讓自己生活得更快樂的東西，是讓人無法拒絕的。

sentences.traditional: 作為最常見的寵物之一，貓被人類飼養的歷史十分悠久。

sentences.simplified: 在中国古代人眼中，万物有灵，猫尤其如此。
sentences.traditional: 在中國古代人眼中，萬物有靈，貓尤其如此。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhōng guó gǔ dài rén yǎn zhōng wàn wù yǒu líng māo yóu qí rú cǐ
sentences.english: As one of the most common pets, cats have been kept by humans for a long time.

sentences.simplified: 从最初的仓库守卫者，到通佛性的灵者，
sentences.traditional: 從最初的倉庫守衛者，到通佛性的靈者，
sentences.pinyin: cóng zuì chū de cāng kù shǒu wèi zhě dào tōng fó xìng de líng zhě
sentences.english: In the eyes of the ancient Chinese, all things have spirits, and this was especially true of cats.

sentences.simplified: 猫与古代中国人的羁绊似乎越来越深。
sentences.traditional: 貓與古代中國人的羈絆似乎越來越深。
sentences.pinyin: māo yǔ gǔ dài zhōng guó rén de jī bàn sì hū yuè lái yuè shēn
sentences.english: From the original storehouse guards to the spiritual beings connected to their Buddha nature, ..
.. the bond between cats and the ancient Chinese seems to have gotten deeper and deeper.

sentences.simplified: 秦汉时期，为了震慑老鼠，减少仓库的损失，人们选择养猫。
sentences.traditional: 秦漢時期，為了震懾老鼠，減少倉庫的損失，人們選擇養貓。
sentences.pinyin: qín hàn shí qī wèi le zhèn shè lǎo shǔ jiǎn shǎo cāng kù de sǔn shī rén men xuǎn zé yǎng māo

sentences.simplified: 人们把猫定位为看守仓库的卫士，会在农历十二月八日祭祀猫神。
sentences.traditional: 人們把貓定位為看守倉庫的衛士，會在農曆十二月八日祭祀貓神。
sentences.pinyin: rén men bǎ māo dìng wèi wèi kān shǒu cāng kù de wèi shì huì zài nóng lì shí èr yuè bā rì jì sì māo shén
sentences.english: During the Qin and Han dynasties, people chose to keep cats in order to deter rats and reduce losses in storehouses.

sentences.simplified: 这一时期，猫逐渐成为了家庭成员，人们开始给猫取名字。
sentences.traditional: 這一時期，貓逐漸成為了家庭成員，人們開始給貓取名字。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yì shí qī māo zhú jiàn chéng wéi le jiā tíng chéng yuán rén men kāi shǐ gěi māo qǔ míng zi
sentences.english: People used cats as guards of storehouses and would worship the cat god on the 8th day of the 12th lunar month.
During this period, cats gradually became family members, and people began to give them names.

sentences.simplified: 到了唐宋时期，猫从仓库卫士变成了伴侣宠物，
sentences.traditional: 到了唐宋時期，貓從倉庫衛士變成了伴侶寵物，
sentences.pinyin: dào le táng sòng shí qī māo cóng cāng kù wèi shì biàn chéng le bàn lǚ chǒng wù

sentences.simplified: 已经出现了一些人开始像对待家人一样对待猫的现象。
sentences.traditional: 已經出現了一些人開始像對待家人一樣對待貓的現象。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ jīng chū xiàn le yì xiē rén kāi shǐ xiàng duì dài jiā rén yí yàng duì dài māo de xiàn xiàng
sentences.english: By the Tang and Song dynasties, cats had changed from storehouse guards to companion pets, ..

sentences.simplified: 到了宋朝，养猫开始有了固定的流程：第一步，看日历。
sentences.traditional: 到了宋朝，養貓開始有了固定的流程：第一步，看日曆。
sentences.pinyin: dào le sòng cháo yǎng māo kāi shǐ yǒu le gù dìng de liú chéng dì yī bù kàn rì lì
sentences.english: .. and the phenomenon of some people treating them like family members had already started to appear.

sentences.simplified: 人们通过专门的养猫日历，选择一个适合迎接猫回家的日子。
sentences.traditional: 人們通過專門的養貓日曆，選擇一個適合迎接貓回家的日子。
sentences.pinyin: rén men tōng guò zhuān mén de yǎng māo rì lì xuǎn zé yí ge shì hé yíng jiē māo huí jiā de rì zi
sentences.english: By the Song Dynasty, getting a cat started to have a fixed process: The first step was to look at the calendar.

sentences.simplified: 日子一到，就来到了第二步，下聘礼。
sentences.traditional: 日子一到，就來到了第二步，下聘禮。
sentences.pinyin: rì zi yí dào jiù lái dào le dì èr bù xià pìn lǐ
sentences.english: People chose a suitable day to welcome their cats home using a special calendar for getting a cat.

sentences.simplified: 在这一天，人们要带着契约书和聘礼来迎接小猫回家。
sentences.traditional: 在這一天，人們要帶著契約書和聘禮來迎接小貓回家。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè yì tiān rén men yào dài zhe qì yuē shū hé pìn lǐ lái yíng jiē xiǎo māo huí jiā
sentences.english: Once the day arrived, it was time for the second step, the betrothal gift.

sentences.simplified: 契约书上不但写着猫的外貌和性格，
sentences.traditional: 契約書上不但寫著貓的外貌和性格，
sentences.pinyin: qì yuē shū shang bú dàn xiě zhe māo de wài mào hé xìng gé
sentences.english: On this day, people were expected to bring a contract and a betrothal gift to welcome the kitten home.

sentences.simplified: 还写着“要把小猫带回家共度一生，请各位神仙见证”这样的话。
sentences.traditional: 還寫著“要把小貓帶回家共度一生，請各位神仙見證”這樣的話。
sentences.pinyin: hái xiě zhe yào bǎ xiǎo māo dài huí jiā gòng dù yì shēng qǐng gè wèi shén xiān jiàn zhèng zhè yàng de huà
sentences.english: The contract not only stated the appearance and temperament of the cat, ..

sentences.simplified: 聘礼则是送给猫妈妈的主人的，一般是小鱼或者盐；
sentences.traditional: 聘禮則是送給貓媽媽的主人的，一般是小魚或者鹽；
sentences.pinyin: pìn lǐ zé shì sòng gěi māo mā ma de zhǔ rén de yì bān shì xiǎo yú huò zhě yán
sentences.english: .. words such as “taking the kitten home to spend a lifetime together, asking the immortals to bear witness” were also written.

sentences.simplified: 如果是野生的小猫，也要串一串小鱼送给猫妈妈。
sentences.traditional: 如果是野生的小貓，也要串一串小魚送給貓媽媽。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ shì yě shēng de xiǎo māo yě yào chuàn yí chuàn xiǎo yú sòng gěi māo mā ma
sentences.english: The betrothal gift was given to the owner of the mother cat, usually small fish or salt.

sentences.simplified: 回家以后就是第三步，进门。
sentences.traditional: 回家以後就是第三步，進門。
sentences.pinyin: huí jiā yǐ hòu jiù shì dì sān bù jìn mén
sentences.english: If it was a wild kitten, a skewer of small fish was also given to the mother cat.

sentences.simplified: 在这一步，人们要带小猫认识家里人，也会跟家神和狗打招呼。
sentences.traditional: 在這一步，人們要帶小貓認識家裡人，也會跟家神和狗打招呼。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè yí bù rén men yào dài xiǎo māo rèn shi jiā lǐ rén yě huì gēn jiā shén hé gǒu dǎ zhāo hu
sentences.english: It was time for the third step when they got home, to join the household.

sentences.simplified: 总的来说，就是简易的娶妻流程。
sentences.traditional: 總的來說，就是簡易的娶妻流程。
sentences.pinyin: zǒng de lái shuō jiù shì jiǎn yì de qǔ qī liú chéng
sentences.english: In this step, people took the kitten to meet the family and also greet the household gods and dogs.

sentences.simplified: 可以说，宋代人已经很接近当代的猫奴了。
sentences.traditional: 可以說，宋代人已經很接近當代的貓奴了。
sentences.pinyin: kě yǐ shuō sòng dài rén yǐ jīng hěn jiē jìn dāng dài de māo nú le
sentences.english: In short, it was a simplified process of taking a wife.
It can be said that the people of the Song Dynasty were very similar to contemporary “cat slaves”.

sentences.simplified: 说到当代猫奴，猫的陪伴，猫的懒，
sentences.traditional: 說到當代貓奴，貓的陪伴，貓的懶，
sentences.pinyin: shuō dào dāng dài māo nú māo de péi bàn māo de lǎn

sentences.simplified: 猫的淘气，都是当代猫奴喜欢猫的原因。
sentences.traditional: 貓的淘氣，都是當代貓奴喜歡貓的原因。
sentences.pinyin: māo de táo qì dōu shì dāng dài māo nú xǐ huan māo de yuán yīn
sentences.english: When it comes to contemporary “cat slaves”, the companionship of cats, the laziness of cats, ..

sentences.simplified: 古代人也是如此。
sentences.traditional: 古代人也是如此。
sentences.pinyin: gǔ dài rén yě shì rú cǐ
sentences.english: .. and the mischievousness of cats are all reasons why contemporary “cat slaves” love cats.

sentences.simplified: 从宋代开始，就有很多人给自己的猫写诗了，
sentences.traditional: 從宋代開始，就有很多人給自己的貓寫詩了，
sentences.pinyin: cóng sòng dài kāi shǐ jiù yǒu hěn duō rén gěi zì jǐ de māo xiě shī le
sentences.english: The same was true for ancient people.

sentences.simplified: 给猫洗澡、驱虫这些就更不用提了，都有专门的时间和方法。
sentences.traditional: 給貓洗澡、驅蟲這些就更不用提了，都有專門的時間和方法。
sentences.pinyin: gěi māo xǐ zǎo qū chóng zhè xiē jiù gèng bú yòng tí le dōu yǒu zhuān mén de shí jiān hé fāng fǎ
sentences.english: Since the Song Dynasty, many people have written poems to their cats, ..

sentences.simplified: 总的来说，古代人和现代人爱猫的心情是共通的。
sentences.traditional: 總的來說，古代人和現代人愛貓的心情是共通的。
sentences.pinyin: zǒng de lái shuō gǔ dài rén hé xiàn dài rén ài māo de xīn qíng shì gòng tōng de
sentences.english: .. not to mention bathing and deworming them, all using special schedules and methods.

sentences.simplified: 毕竟，能让自己生活得更快乐的东西，是让人无法拒绝的。
sentences.traditional: 畢竟，能讓自己生活得更快樂的東西，是讓人無法拒絕的。
sentences.pinyin: bì jìng néng ràng zì jǐ shēng huó de gèng kuài lè de dōng xi shì ràng rén wú fǎ jù jué de
sentences.english: In general, the love of cats is a feeling that ancient people and modern people have in common.

sentence_translations: The Lives of Ancient People: How Ancient People Kept Cats
As one of the most common pets, cats have been kept by humans for a long time.
In the eyes of the ancient Chinese, all things have spirits, and this was especially true of cats.
From the original storehouse guards to the spiritual beings connected to their Buddha nature, ..
.. the bond between cats and the ancient Chinese seems to have gotten deeper and deeper.
During the Qin and Han dynasties, people chose to keep cats in order to deter rats and reduce losses in storehouses.
People used cats as guards of storehouses and would worship the cat god on the 8th day of the 12th lunar month.
During this period, cats gradually became family members, and people began to give them names.
By the Tang and Song dynasties, cats had changed from storehouse guards to companion pets, ..
.. and the phenomenon of some people treating them like family members had already started to appear.
By the Song Dynasty, getting a cat started to have a fixed process: The first step was to look at the calendar.
People chose a suitable day to welcome their cats home using a special calendar for getting a cat.
Once the day arrived, it was time for the second step, the betrothal gift.
On this day, people were expected to bring a contract and a betrothal gift to welcome the kitten home.
The contract not only stated the appearance and temperament of the cat, ..
.. words such as “taking the kitten home to spend a lifetime together, asking the immortals to bear witness” were also written.
The betrothal gift was given to the owner of the mother cat, usually small fish or salt.
If it was a wild kitten, a skewer of small fish was also given to the mother cat.
It was time for the third step when they got home, to join the household.
In this step, people took the kitten to meet the family and also greet the household gods and dogs.
In short, it was a simplified process of taking a wife.
It can be said that the people of the Song Dynasty were very similar to contemporary “cat slaves”.
When it comes to contemporary “cat slaves”, the companionship of cats, the laziness of cats, ..
.. and the mischievousness of cats are all reasons why contemporary “cat slaves” love cats.
The same was true for ancient people.
Since the Song Dynasty, many people have written poems to their cats, ..
.. not to mention bathing and deworming them, all using special schedules and methods.
In general, the love of cats is a feeling that ancient people and modern people have in common.
After all, it’s impossible to say no to something that makes our lives happier.
